description: Validate JSON field presence, exact types, primitive enums and inclusive numeric bounds, returning ALLOW/BLOCK, field reasons and checked_fields. Combine required:true, type:"integer" and min:1 for a positive mandatory quantity: min alone neither requires a value nor rejects numeric strings. Missing, null or empty optional values skip the other constraints; 0 and false do not. For nested data, fields["order.total"] addresses a leaf; allow_extra:false compares top-level keys, so keep it true for dot-path rules. Use trust_clean_data for transformations or trust_check_action for evidence/spending checks. This validates structure, not facts or provenance. Free, unauthenticated, stateless pilot: rules apply only to this call. Usage metadata is recorded; request bodies are not stored.

inputSchema.description: Object and field rules to validate.

allow_extra.description: False rejects top-level keys absent from fields. With nested dot paths use true; this flag is not a recursive additional-properties check.

data.description: JSON object to inspect; do not submit secrets or personal data.

additionalProperties.description: A field constraint. Optional missing values are skipped; required rejects missing, null and empty string.

enum.description: Allowed primitive values, compared without coercion.

max.description: Inclusive upper bound, applied only to numeric values.

min.description: Inclusive lower bound, applied only to numeric values.

type.description: Expected JSON type; no coercion is performed.

fields.description: Map of dot-separated field paths to constraints, e.g. {"order.total":{"type":"number","min":0,"required":true}}. Inline rules apply only to this request.

name: trust_validate_data

outputSchema.description: Structured result, also serialized in the text content block.

ok.description: The operation completed; does not imply the verdict is ALLOW.

reasons.description: All failed checks; empty when ALLOW.

items.description: A deterministic finding; codes identify the violated check.

row.description: Zero-based input row index, when applicable.

verdict.description: Advisory verdict. The integrator must prevent execution on BLOCK or any error.

title: Validate JSON field constraints
